newsitem.title: USA: Metromedia sets subordinated debt redemption.
newsitem.headline: Metromedia sets subordinated debt redemption.

text.p: Metromedia International Group Inc on Friday announced the dates on which it will redeem at par plus accrued interest to the date of redemption all of its outstanding subordinated debentures.
The aggregate principal amount of MMG's subordinated debentures to be repaid is about $140 million, it said.
The company had previously announced the redemption plan in a proxy statement to shareholders.

The company said its 9.5 percent subordinated debentures due Aug. 1, 1998, and 10 percent subordinated debentures due Oct. 1, 1999, are to be redeemed on Aug. 10, it said. Its 6.5 percent convertible subordinated debentures due on Aug. 1, 2002, are to be redeemed on Aug. 20.
